adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx`, the client defines `const ZAddGuestsInputSchema = z.array(z.string().email()).refine(...)` inside the component body, so it is re-created on every render and independently duplicates (part of) the server-side validation (`guests: z.array(z.string().email())` in `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts`).
